<description>
`CreateNewBlock_validity` mines a 110-block chain and then runs four subtests on it as member functions. The subtests share one chain, so each starts from whatever the previous one left behind, and the caller has to patch `Tip()->nHeight` between them. Inside `TestBasicMining` a single `CMutableTransaction` is reused across all sections, with each section overwriting some of its fields, so the transaction a section actually tests depends on every section before it.

This PR removes both kinds of hidden state.
</description>

<commits>
838e901e90 test: construct TestBasicMining transactions declaratively

Construct the transactions of each TestBasicMining section in place
instead of reusing a single transaction across all sections and
overwriting some of its fields.

7e81f5046e test: split CreateNewBlock_validity into separate test cases

The sub-tests ran as member functions on one shared chain, so each
started from the state the previous one left behind and the caller had
to patch Tip()->nHeight between them.

Make them independent test cases, each mining the BLOCKINFO chain via a
new MineBlockInfoChain() helper. The blocks use hardcoded nonces, so
doing this once per case is cheap.
</commits>
